signature.why: The colorless Eldrazi engine, 4-of in 10/10 current field lists. Temple and Labyrinth are the mana, Rumble and Mycospawn find the missing piece, and Kozilek's Command is the flexible Eldrazi spell all of it is spent on.

The ramp half, which is what makes this ramp rather than tron or the Broodscale combo. The field runs it two ways and the clause covers both: a creature build on Disciple of Freyalise, Fanatic of Rhonas and Slumbering Trudge found with Green Sun's Zenith, and an enchantment-and-rock build on 4 Utopia Sprawl plus 4 Talisman. Seven of the ten current field lists are the first, three are the second, and none of them assembles Tron - these are the cards that turn Forests into the seven mana Emrakul costs.

What the ramp is for. 10/10 field lists run Emrakul at 3.7 copies on average and the thinnest top end in the field is three copies, which is the floor here: a ramp deck is defined as much by what it ramps to as by the accelerants, and this clause is what stops a green midrange list holding a Temple from matching.

exclude.why: Tron lands. A list that ramps with Eldrazi Temple AND assembles Tron is one of the two tron branches, which have their own guides; eldrazi ramp reaches seven mana off Forests and Disciple of Freyalise instead, and 0/10 of its field lists run a Tron land.
